#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
# Matrix captions: mapped knob indices, sparse rows and clear navigation.
set -eu
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.."
OUT=${1:-build/matrix-knob-caption}
mkdir -p "$OUT"
awk '/^static void smk_wheels\(void\)/{on=1} on{print} on && /^}/{exit}' firmware/src/app/main_fm1.c > "$OUT/smk_wheels.inc"
test -s "$OUT/smk_wheels.inc"
sh host/build_host.sh --generate-only >"$OUT/assets.log" 2>&1
U="firmware/src/dsp/drum909.c firmware/src/dsp/drum808.c firmware/src/dsp/x0x_param.c firmware/src/dsp/bass303.c firmware/src/dsp/breaks.c firmware/src/dsp/fxbus.c firmware/src/dsp/master.c firmware/src/seq/sequencer.c firmware/src/seq/tb3po.c firmware/src/seq/pattern.c firmware/src/seq/motion.c firmware/src/app/engine.c firmware/src/app/factory_banks.c experiments/wobble/wobble.c"
# shellcheck disable=SC2086
${CC:-cc} -O0 -g -ffp-contract=off -std=c99 -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-function -Wno-unused-parameter ${SAN_FLAGS:-} \
 -DX0X_HOST -DX0X_BASS_PUBLISH_TEST=1 -DX0X_SMK_CAPTIONS=${X0X_TEST_SMK_CAPTIONS:-1} -DX0X_WOBBLE=1 -DX0X_DEV_WOBBLE=1 -DX0X_BASS_PRESET_PREVIEW=1 -DX0X_BASS_TAGGED_SOUND=1 \
 -Ifirmware/src -Ifirmware/src/app -Ifirmware/src/dsp -Ibuild/gen -I"$OUT" tests/host/matrix_knob_caption_test.c $U -lm -o "$OUT/test"
"$OUT/test" "$OUT"

X0X

Break loops

Your own loops for X0X's BREAK part. They appear on the device as BR1, BR2 and so on, after X0X's own loops, when you turn LOOP A or LOOP B (BREAK, then EDIT).

Connect the SMK-37 or FM-1 by USB with X0X running, and use Chrome or Edge.

Connect to see the loops on the FM-1.
or drop files here. Drop one on a loop to replace it.

Preview before adding

Listen to the processed loop (with crunch and device encoding). Cancel leaves the device and your loop list unchanged.

Preview before sending

These slots will be rewritten on the device. Listen first if you like. Cancel does not write anything.
A backup is a file with every slot as it is on the device. Restore writes it back.

New loops are stored at 44.1 kHz. A one-bar loop at 120 BPM takes about 86 KB; tick "22 kHz" to fit twice as many at a lower quality. Loops follow the tempo by playing faster or slower, so their pitch follows it too; the break's PITCH knob shifts it. Removing a loop renumbers the ones after it, so patterns that used them play the next loop instead. The manual's BREAK section says how X0X plays a loop.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""Native no-device tests for linkless atomic backup and fail-closed handling."""
import errno
import importlib.util
import os
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest import mock

source = Path(os.environ.get("X0X_SLOTS_SOURCE", Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "tools" / "x0x_slots.py"))
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("x0x_slots_atomic_under_test", source)
slots = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(slots)


class PortableBackupTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.work = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.work.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.work.name)
        self.path = self.root / "samples.x0xslots"
        lay = {"count": 1, "size": 81920, "slots": [{"size": 81920, "nz": 0, "off": None}]}
        self.a = slots.make_archive(lay, [None], "2026-10-23T00:00:00Z")
        self.b = slots.make_archive(lay, [None], "2026-10-24T00:00:00Z")
        slots.read_archive(self.a)
        slots.read_archive(self.b)

    def stages(self):
        return list(self.root.glob(".samples.x0xslots.*.tmp"))

    @staticmethod
    def no_hardlinks(*args, **kwargs):
        raise OSError(errno.EOPNOTSUPP, "simulated unsupported link")

    @unittest.skipUnless(os.name == "posix" and os.uname().sysname == "Linux", "native Linux renameat2 test")
    def test_linkless_atomic_publish_creates_readable_backup(self):
        with mock.patch.object(slots.os, "link", side_effect=self.no_hardlinks):
            slots.save_backup_archive(self.path, self.b)
        self.assertEqual(slots.read_archive(self.path.read_bytes())[0]["count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), self.b)
        self.assertEqual(self.stages(), [])

    def test_hardlink_path_unchanged(self):
        slots.save_backup_archive(self.path, self.a)
        self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), self.a)
        self.assertEqual(self.stages(), [])

    def test_concurrent_creator_wins_on_linkless_filesystem(self):
        def raced(*args, **kwargs):
            self.path.write_bytes(self.a)
            raise OSError(errno.EOPNOTSUPP, "simulated missing hardlinks")
        with mock.patch.object(slots.os, "link", side_effect=raced):
            with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):
                slots.save_backup_archive(self.path, self.b)
        self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), self.a)
        self.assertEqual(self.stages(), [])

    def test_symlink_conflict_is_not_followed(self):
        target = self.root / "precious.x0xslots"
        target.write_bytes(self.a)
        self.path.symlink_to(target)
        with mock.patch.object(slots.os, "link", side_effect=self.no_hardlinks):
            with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):
                slots.save_backup_archive(self.path, self.b)
        self.assertTrue(self.path.is_symlink())
        self.assertEqual(target.read_bytes(), self.a)
        self.assertEqual(self.stages(), [])

    def test_unsupported_atomic_rename_explains_remediation_and_cleans_stage(self):
        with mock.patch.object(slots.os, "link", side_effect=self.no_hardlinks), \
             mock.patch.object(slots, "_rename_backup_noreplace", side_effect=slots.SlotError("filesystem cannot atomically publish backup")):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(slots.SlotError, "filesystem cannot atomically publish"):
                slots.save_backup_archive(self.path, self.b)
        self.assertFalse(self.path.exists())
        self.assertEqual(self.stages(), [])

    def test_permission_error_never_falls_back(self):
        with mock.patch.object(slots.os, "link", side_effect=PermissionError(errno.EPERM, "permission denied")), \
             mock.patch.object(slots, "_rename_backup_noreplace") as native:
            with self.assertRaises(PermissionError):
                slots.save_backup_archive(self.path, self.b)
        native.assert_not_called()
        self.assertFalse(self.path.exists())
        self.assertEqual(self.stages(), [])

    def test_existing_destination_not_modified_by_linkless_path(self):
        self.path.write_bytes(self.a)
        with mock.patch.object(slots.os, "link", side_effect=self.no_hardlinks):
            with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):
                slots.save_backup_archive(self.path, self.b)
        self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), self.a)
        self.assertEqual(self.stages(), [])

    def test_corrupted_archive_rejected_before_stage_or_link(self):
        with mock.patch.object(slots.os, "link", side_effect=AssertionError("must not link")):
            with self.assertRaises(slots.SlotError):
                slots.save_backup_archive(self.path, self.b[:-4] + b"bad!")
        self.assertFalse(self.path.exists())
        self.assertEqual(self.stages(), [])

    def test_replace_path_does_not_depend_on_link(self):
        self.path.write_bytes(self.a)
        with mock.patch.object(slots.os, "link", side_effect=self.no_hardlinks):
            slots.save_backup_archive(self.path, self.b, replace=True)
        self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), self.b)
        self.assertEqual(self.stages(), [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main(verbosity=2)

#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
# Tempo-rate regression and sanitizer coverage; no private audio inputs.
set -eu
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.."
OUT=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$OUT"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
for mode in normal sanitized; do
 flags='-O2'
 if [ "$mode" = sanitized ]; then flags='-O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all'; fi
 ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 $flags -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wno-error=attributes -ffp-contract=off -DX0X_SYNTH_HOST_TEST -Ifirmware/src tests/host/miami_tempo_test.c experiments/wobble/wobble.c firmware/src/dsp/bass303.c -lm -o "$OUT/$mode"
 "$OUT/$mode"
done
